answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 45917 Country: India Title: Salah Question: (1) What do the holy Quran and Hadith say about those who don't say any salah not even Friday salah and also do not keep sawm even in the month of Ramadan? (2) To what degree of Muslim can we consider them? Answer ID: 45917 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1346/1020/B=10/1434) (1) Such a person is also Muslim. (2) But he is transgressor and sinner. He shall be given bath after his death like any other Muslim and wrapped in coffin and his janazah salah shall also be offered and he shall be buried in the graveyard of Muslims as per Islamic rites. He shall be treated like Muslim. Such a person should be preached and informed of religious matters time and again. Efforts should also be made to send him in tablighi jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
